update: Referral system + new features — backend implementation guide

auth.note: Same token issued by /api/sign-in-user/ and /api/sign-in-with-pin/ — no new auth needed

conventions: Django-style trailing slashes on all paths
Every new response uses the existing { success, message, data } envelope (same as /api/support/, /api/wallet/{id}/)

referral.status: Frontend currently renders demo JSON (src/utils/mockData.js -> MOCK_REWARDS). Wire these endpoints when ready and the UI changes nothing except dropping the mock.
referral.concept: Every user gets a unique referral code + link. A friend who signs up with that code is linked (User.referredBy). Forever after, whenever that friend pays any bill (airtime/data/cable/electricity), the referrer automatically earns a percentage commission into their referral balance. The referrer withdraws the bonus to wallet or bank from the Rewards page.

commissionRates.note: Admin-editable later (recommended: store in a settings table, clamp any value to 0.1..0.7)

User.referralCode: string, unique, auto-generated at signup (e.g. CHIDY2024)
User.referredBy: FK -> User, nullable — set once at signup from referralCode, never changes

ReferralEarning.payer: FK User (the referred friend who paid the bill)
ReferralEarning.productAmount: number — the bill amount that generated the earning

endpoints.purpose: Signup with referral code (extend the EXISTING endpoint — do not create a new one)
endpoints.change: Accept optional field referralCode. If present: look up User by referralCode — not found -> { success:false, message:'Invalid referral code' }. If found, set new user's referredBy = that user, and generate the new user's own unique referralCode.

endpoints.purpose: Rewards page + home card referral row (single call for the whole dashboard)

commission.note: One-time bonus when a referred friend completes their first bill payment

howItWorks: Share your referral link or code with friends and family.
They sign up on SubBridge and verify their account.
You earn a bonus once they complete their first bill payment.
Withdraw your bonus to your wallet or bank anytime.

endpoints.purpose: Recent earnings, paged (optional — only if the list outgrows the dashboard response)
Withdraw Bonus — Rewards page button, sheet offers Transfer to Wallet / Transfer to Bank
rules: method wallet: debit referralBalance, credit wallet balance (same wallet as /api/wallet/{id}/), status=paid
method bank: debit referralBalance, create ReferralWithdrawal with status=pending (admin payout queue), status=pending

integrationWithOtherFeatures.goal: Referral earnings must be CONTINUOUS — every bill paid by a referred user earns the referrer automatically, with zero frontend changes to the purchase flows.
integrationWithOtherFeatures.hook: Run this inside every purchase handler AFTER the purchase succeeds (HTTP success already returned to wallet debit done):
steps: 1. buyer = the user who just paid. If buyer.referredBy is null -> stop (nothing to do).
4. Create ReferralEarning(referrer=buyer.referredBy, payer=buyer, product, productAmount, rate, amount=commission, status='paid').
5. referrer.referralBalance += commission; referrer.totalEarnings += commission; referrer.monthEarnings += commission.
6. Optional one-time first-payment bonus: if this is buyer's FIRST successful purchase ever, also credit referrer with commission.perReferral (default 500).
integrationWithOtherFeatures.monthlyReset: Cron on the 1st of each month: monthEarnings = 0 for all users. referralBalance and totalEarnings are never reset.
integrationWithOtherFeatures.totalUsers: COUNT of users where referredBy = this user (computed at signup; can be a denormalized counter incremented on each referred signup).

frontendWiring.homeCard: HomeScreen 'Referral' row + Withdraw Bonus button -> Rewards route; row shows data.referralBalance
frontendWiring.rewardsPage: RewardsScreen maps data -> 2x2 stats grid, referral link + code (copy), Share (RN Share), How it works, Referral commission, Referral commission rates box, Recent earnings (product + productAmount + amount)
frontendWiring.withdraw: Sticky Withdraw Bonus button -> sheet (Transfer to Wallet / Transfer to Bank) -> POST /api/referral/withdraw/

automatedFunding.source: GET /api/wallet/{userId}/ already returns bankName + accountNumber (the dedicated virtual account). The Add Money sheet displays these with a copy button.

oneTimeFunding.status: coming soon — frontend shows a 'Coming soon' row, tapping it shows a toast

plannedEndpoint.purpose: Issue a short-lived one-time account for a specific amount
plannedEndpoint.creditRule: When an inflow hits the one-time account before expiresAt, credit the wallet by the received amount and mark the reference settled.

airtimeToCash.status: Frontend composes a professional WhatsApp message (user's SubBridge name, network, amount, bank name, account number, account name) and opens wa.me/<support-whatsapp>?text=... using the number from GET /api/support/. No API required. Optional endpoint below if you want server-side logging + admin queue.

optionalEndpoint.purpose: Log airtime-to-cash requests (admin processes payout offline)

deliveryOrder: 1. Extend /api/sign-up/ with optional referralCode + generate referralCode for every new user (backfill existing users too)
2. GET /api/referral/ (dashboard — unlocks the whole Rewards page + home card)
3. Commission hooks inside the 4 purchase endpoints (makes earnings continuous)
4. POST /api/referral/withdraw/ (Transfer to Wallet first — easiest, then bank payout queue)

frontendNotes.swapToLive: When endpoints are ready: in RewardsScreen replace `import { MOCK_REWARDS }` with api.getReferral() (add it to api.js like the other endpoints); HomeScreen referral row reads the same response. Everything else stays.
frontendNotes.airtimeToCash: Already live on WhatsApp — the optional endpoint is only for your records.
